products.name: Delivered
products.tagline: The FDE operations console: onboarding, deployments and the data room for the forward-deployed team.

stamped: state/application/<app_id>/ filled against all four schemas
mold builds on VM (npm run build, typecheck)
lanes_passing: all five lanes pass on the stamped app

every lane has a harness: accessibility (a11y.mjs) and responsiveness (responsive.mjs) built 2026-09-08, load (testing/load/stress.py) built 2026-09-09 (mold_v1-024); functional and context are the mold's own suites
deployed: production URL on Vercel — the one committed deploy target; target: vm verifies an app's database locally and does not serve it (mold_v1-020, infra/vm/README.md)
secrets present by name only in state
the app's inference provider configured and smoke-tested (GLM 5.2 on Cloudflare Workers AI, or Claude Sonnet 5 on the Vercel AI Gateway)
released: onboarding path works end to end on a stamped app (docs/RUNBOOK.md: intake, provision, the customer credentials (four on Cloudflare Workers AI, three on the Vercel AI Gateway), deploy, clone.py configure, emailed-code sign-in, then the mold's fde:onboard-self / fde:new-org / fde:new-customer)
docs + pricing/packaging decided (docs/PRODUCTS.md; pricing still a placeholder)
budget of inference cost per workspace known (docs/COST_MODEL.md: prices fetched, volumes measured from automation_runs rather than placeholders)
